test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

High horse

options.text: To be the person in charge

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3: An attitude of moral superiority'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom 'High horse' refers to an attitude of convinced superiority in relation to others. In Hindi, it's equivalent would be "अच्छी संवेदनाशीलता का दावा" or "व्यक्ति जो स्वयं को दूसरों से बेहतर समझता है". 
 
• After making this comparison, it becomes evident that the correct answer is **'Option 3**: An attitude of moral superiority'.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: '*An attitude of moral superiority'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To be very lucky doesn't align with the translation or meaning of 'High horse'. (बहुत भाग्यशाली होना)
 
• To have a low self-esteem again doesn't align with the meaning of 'High horse'.(निम्न स्व-सम्मान रखना)
 
• To be the person in charge again doesn't match with the meaning of 'High horse'.(सिरपरस्त होना)

20f:T9fd,
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.** i.e.** 'Rescind'.**</d
